PACK-DL-ALLOWLIST-001.title: Pack downloads are host-allowlisted, bounded in size, and count redirects instead of looping
PACK-DL-ALLOWLIST-001.summary: Pack downloads are pinned to the reviewed catalog origin: one http client, host allow-list, scheme+host policy, capped redirects, size-capped streaming, and a live proof that both pinned catalog entries install through the native transport.
PACK-DL-ALLOWLIST-001.notes: The live proof is `#[ignore]`d so the ordinary suite stays offline; the recorded artifact runs it explicitly (`-- --ignored both_pinned`). Redirects are capped at MAX_REDIRECT_HOPS (5) and are re-checked against the allow-list on every hop; the fetch is capped at the pinned size, and a mid-stream overrun fails with an explicit error. The catalog itself still mislabels both packs' licence, which is the owner's O-01b republish decision, not a transport fix.

MINE-PLAN-001.title: Mined items get their own scheduler partition so the plan cannot starve
MINE-PLAN-001.summary: Mined content is separated from authored content by a scheduler partition tag, so the mined FSRS spike cannot contaminate the authored path or its coverage claims.
MINE-PLAN-001.notes: Verified in the build path: the partition tag is a function of the *emitted item*, never of the request (apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/lib.rs plans content with `fsrs-spike-0.1.0+mined`).

PLAN-SCOPE-001.title: Plan and mastery lookups are scoped to the active pack or to global items
PLAN-SCOPE-001.summary: Planning is bounded by the studied pack; switching packs keeps plan generation fast instead of deriving mastery across every installed pack.
PLAN-SCOPE-001.notes: Measured: the two-pack scenario returns one saved-review item (`PlanReason::SavedReview`) and stays bounded.

SUPPORT-ACCOUNTING-001.title: Support actions are recorded with one shared vocabulary and never credited
SUPPORT-ACCOUNTING-001.summary: Support moves (first_error, hint, example, reformulation, choice_support, native_support, translation_support, chunking, slower_audio) are recorded on every attempt and disqualify credit instead of being hidden or credited.
SUPPORT-ACCOUNTING-001.notes: Policy 0.2.0 declares the disqualification sets; scenario sessions carry the support actions a lesson revealed and still abstain rather than credit. The policy document is a proposed artifact awaiting owner acceptance.

EVIDENCE-IDENTITY-001.title: Evidence identity is a prompt family with an app-issued session id, never an event id
EVIDENCE-IDENTITY-001.summary: One learner action yields one evidence event: attempt groups collapse transcript/word/choice evidence, and a scenario session records one scored event per turn.
EVIDENCE-IDENTITY-001.notes: Pinned with an exact event count in the Russian gate measurement; duplicate event ids are a real defect because `Store::append_evidence` ignores conflicting ids (`ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`).

RU-GOAL-PREREQ-001.title: Russian on-ramp goal prerequisites are satisfied and enforced
RU-GOAL-PREREQ-001.summary: The Russian on-ramp gate is reachable: practising the cyrillic prerequisite on its own dimension unlocks the greetings goal through the engine.
RU-GOAL-PREREQ-001.notes: 67 prerequisite concepts, hard prerequisite on orthography-recognition to `independent`; the measurement reaches the gate on the final required concept. The earlier claim that the desktop could not reach it was wrong: two authored prompt families make `Independent` reachable.

GOAL-DISPLAY-QUALIFIER-001.title: Goal display states evidence coverage and cannot overstate one concept
GOAL-DISPLAY-QUALIFIER-001.summary: The goal surface states which dimension a prerequisite or level applies to, including locked goals and their blocking reason.
GOAL-DISPLAY-QUALIFIER-001.notes: `GoalDimensionView` carries `state_kebab`/`source`/`independent_evidence_at`, and the goal map reports `locked` plus `prerequisites` with dimension and required state. Frontend coverage is component-level (`home.test.tsx`); DOM-level journey coverage belongs to JOURNEY-SUITE-001.

SPEECH-DISPATCH-001.title: Speech checks only run the measures the installed runtime instruments, for the pack language
SPEECH-DISPATCH-001.summary: Speech features declare the pack locale and ASR language they target, and abstain before touching audio when the measure is not instrumented for that language.
SPEECH-DISPATCH-001.notes: The aligner language comes from the pack manifest (uninstalled or manifest-less packs yield `pack-locale-unknown`); the pronunciation surface pins its `feature-not-instrumented` abstention.

AUTHORED-STAGE-001.title: Packs author stages, and the desktop runs the pack's order
AUTHORED-STAGE-001.summary: The authored two-stage progression is a real ladder: the same content id through a supported stage and then a transfer stage reaches a higher state, with one prompt family per stage.
AUTHORED-STAGE-001.notes: `running_the_authored_stages_makes_independent_reachable` covers the ladder; placement still caps at `supported` because one assessment sample yields one prompt family.

CONTENT-DEPTH-001.title: Reviewable journey content instead of template volume
CONTENT-DEPTH-001.summary: Upper-level content depth is measured by template coverage and by adding the missing B1/B2 journey content the audit named.
CONTENT-DEPTH-001.notes: The audit (`tools/audit_content_templates.py`, wired into `scripts/ci.sh`) reports per-level activity-form coverage; the Russian journey units (810-818) add past-events, practical-problems and style-register content with listening and speaking activities, and the Japanese pack gained two scenario conversations plus six journey units. Every journey row is draft: `languages/{ru,ja}-*/review/WORKLIST-2026-10-14.md` records zero qualified-human records, and pack audio was generated without SoX (unnormalised levels). ADR-0032 (Proposed) records the media consequence: the tree declares 4902 ja-JP / 4856 ru-RU manifest rows while the pinned published 0.4.0 archives carry 4894 / 4846, because the 18 journey sentences were authored after publication. CI run 38615154690 proved it (rust + desktop-smoke failed the restore step naming exactly those ids). Fix: those 18 generated assets (3.9 MB) are now tracked by name in .gitignore so CI can verify them offline; the exception is bounded and is deleted when the owner republishes at 0.4.1, which must therefore carry these assets. Evidence: fetch-pack-audio.sh --verify-only now reports rows failing=0 at 4902/4856 (state/evidence/CONTENT-DEPTH-001/media-verify-2026-10-14.txt).

ASSESSMENT-RUNNABILITY-001.title: Assessment claims separate definitions from runnable practice and evidence
ASSESSMENT-RUNNABILITY-001.summary: Placement never substitutes or repeats a diagnostic item, and the release coverage report separates authored, mined, assessment and runtime-evidence layers.
ASSESSMENT-RUNNABILITY-001.notes: The placement plan matches goal and modality, skips a goal whose sample content was already used, and abstains rather than swap in a different kind of item.

EXPORT-MINED-001.title: Profile export carries mined support-vocabulary items
EXPORT-MINED-001.summary: Export carries the mined partition, rejects a duplicate profile instead of silently merging, and re-issues ids on import.
EXPORT-MINED-001.notes: Export format version 2; import runs in a `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transaction and a colliding profile id is reported, not merged.

RESTORE-ATOMIC-001.title: Backup restore is a discoverable transactional flow
RESTORE-ATOMIC-001.summary: Restore is preview-then-apply with a safe failure mode: a bad bundle cannot half-write a profile.
RESTORE-ATOMIC-001.notes: `profile_import_preview_at` / `profile_import_at` plus the settings restore controls; storage tests cover the rollback path.

PLAYBACK-LIFECYCLE-001.title: Recording playback survives navigation and failed playback is reported
PLAYBACK-LIFECYCLE-001.summary: Audio playback is single-owner: a new attempt revokes the previous object URL, a revoked URL is never re-attached, and a failed load reports once and settles the control.
PLAYBACK-LIFECYCLE-001.notes: `apps/desktop/src/playback.ts` owns the lifecycle (5 tests: revoke on ended, revoke on error, no double revoke, play rejection settles, unplayed retained URL released); App revokes on unmount and the surface renders a `playback-error` alert. No DOM library exists, so coverage is unit-level.

MIC-TRACK-LIFECYCLE-001.title: Every capture stream and track is stopped on cancel, submit, navigation, unmount, and limit
MIC-TRACK-LIFECYCLE-001.summary: The microphone is a single-owner resource: it is stopped on every exit path, bounded in duration, and a second owner is refused.
MIC-TRACK-LIFECYCLE-001.notes: `apps/desktop/src/capture.ts` (`CaptureOwner`, `captureLimitReached`, `MAX_CAPTURE_SECONDS`); lifecycle coverage is unit-level for the same runner reason as above.

DOC-CONTRACT-RECONCILE-001.title: Onboarding and specification claims match the shipped system
DOC-CONTRACT-RECONCILE-001.summary: Docs and claims that a human has to arbitrate are staged for owner decision: the pack license metadata, the ADRs awaiting acceptance, and the coverage wording that overstates what the desktop can reach.

BUILD-IDENTITY-FRESHNESS-001.title: Build identity is rebuilt when the commit or source changes
BUILD-IDENTITY-FRESHNESS-001.summary: The build identity stamp re-runs when the inputs it reads change, so a runtime report cannot be bound to stale bytes.
BUILD-IDENTITY-FRESHNESS-001.notes: `apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs` declares `.git/HEAD`, the branch ref, `packed-refs`, the index and the crate sources; the recorded probe re-runs after touching `src-tauri/src/lib.rs`.

CAPABILITY-HUB-001.title: The practice hub advertises only what the current build and pack can do, and says so before the dead end
CAPABILITY-HUB-001.summary: The practice hub describes capabilities by what the learner can do and gates the ones the installed pack cannot serve.
CAPABILITY-HUB-001.notes: Kanji drills are hidden until the pack has kanji content (with an honest empty state), the writing surface reveals the form a miss expected, and hub blurbs state whether a mode is graded, guided or formative. Defect found by CI on 2026-10-14 (run 38618485760) and fixed in the same batch: the hub's kanji gate was wired to the drill's lazily-loaded card list (`kanjiCards.length > 0`), which is empty until the mode opens, so the Kanji card hid itself and the drill became unreachable — the desktop walkthrough failed with `hub card "Kanji" missing`. The gate now comes from the pack: a cheap `kanji_available` read (`!kanji_entries(..).is_empty()` for the active pack) fetched when the profile is active, defaulting to available when the read fails so a failed capability probe never silently removes a mode. Evidence: focused Rust test (ja-demo advertises the drill, eo-demo does not) and the full desktop walkthrough against the release binary under xvfb — 13 routes walked, `route:Kanji` acked, no walkthrough error.

LEARNER-COPY-HYGIENE-001.title: Learner-facing copy carries no internal identifiers
LEARNER-COPY-HYGIENE-001.summary: Learner-facing copy names the thing instead of the internal identifier, and onboarding does not promise more than the app can do.
LEARNER-COPY-HYGIENE-001.notes: `tools/audit_learner_copy.py` (added by this fix, run by `scripts/ci.sh` and the CI `schemas` job) scans the renderer sources for the project's own ticket/ADR/gate ids inside string literals and JSX text: 26 source files scanned, 22 test files skipped, 0 findings. Ids stay in comments, tests and docs; onboarding copy was reworded to match the actual capability.

GUIDED-SESSION-001.title: Today presents one bounded session instead of an exhaustive queue
GUIDED-SESSION-001.summary: The learner opens one guided session, works one next task, can pause and resume, and finishes honestly.
GUIDED-SESSION-001.notes: Recorded as a written card for this batch: the underlying pieces exist (lesson encounter, practice runner, attempt groups, support accounting), but the begin/next/pause/resume/finish journey is not wired end to end. Half-wiring it would misrepresent the review.

CANDO-PROGRESS-001.title: Progress leads with can-do decisions and keeps IDs as detail
CANDO-PROGRESS-001.summary: Progress is presented can-do first, with ids and confidence as optional detail.
CANDO-PROGRESS-001.notes: Card recorded from the review; the goal map and coverage display are the seam to build on.

INSTALL-UX-001.title: Installs have real progress, failure recovery, and a receipt
INSTALL-UX-001.summary: Pack install is bounded and honest: real progress, cancel/retry/resume, a receipt, and an explicit decision on pre-archived bundles.
INSTALL-UX-001.notes: The transport hardening is done (PACK-DL-ALLOWLIST-001); the progress/cancel/retry surface and the pre-archived-bundle ADR are not, and the bundle decision is an owner call.

CONTRIBUTOR-REVIEW-PACKET-001.title: A beginner contributor can run one useful check without learning the whole system

CONTRIBUTOR-REVIEW-PACKET-001.notes: Recorded as a card: `docs/PACK_AUTHORING_CONTRACT.md`, the pack gates and the review worklists are the inputs. Content sign-off stays a qualified-human act.

JOURNEY-SUITE-001.title: Automated end-to-end journeys cover the shipped desktop product
JOURNEY-SUITE-001.summary: Mounted end-to-end journeys run against the real components instead of command-level tests.

Pinning the DOM library and native module version is the first step of the card.
